reflection: Explain one choice to a partner.
title: Renewable Energy
description: Sort ten energy sources by whether they are replenished naturally on human timescales.
brief: Sort the energy source, rather than whether it is clean or pollution-free.

groups.label: Non-renewable
groups.description: A finite supply that is used up

items.label: Solar
items.art: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" stroke="#254554" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="76" cy="19" r="9" fill="#efc763"/><path d="M76 3v3M91 19h4M85 8l3-3" stroke="#d7a83f"/><path d="M17 35h62l8 37H9z" fill="#87b7d1"/><path d="M38 35l-2 37M58 35l3 37M13 53h70M48 73v13M33 87h30"/></svg>
items.why: Sunlight is continually supplied by the Sun.

items.label: Wind
items.art: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" stroke="#254554" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M50 42v46M50 42L45 9q7-7 10 2l-2 30M50 42l33 7q6 8-4 8L50 45M50 42L26 67q-10 2-7-8l28-20" fill="#c7ded2"/><circle cx="50" cy="42" r="5" fill="#edba72"/></svg>
items.why: Winds are continually produced by processes in the atmosphere.

items.label: Biomass
items.art: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" stroke="#254554" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M19 72Q13 23 80 16q4 65-52 63z" fill="#9ab982"/><path d="M22 83l48-54M37 65l-5-26M49 52l25 3"/></svg>
items.why: Plant material can regrow. Biomass must be managed so it is replenished.

items.label: Geothermal
items.art: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" stroke="#254554" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M10 68h80M13 83h74" stroke="#a38269"/><path d="M27 56V30h46v26"/><path d="M33 19q-9-9 0-17M51 19q-9-9 0-17M69 19q-9-9 0-17" stroke="#d9956a"/><path d="M39 70v20M61 70v20" stroke="#d9956a"/></svg>
items.why: Heat from inside Earth is a renewable energy source.

items.label: Tidal
items.art: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" stroke="#254554" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8 45q15-17 28 0t28 0 28 0M8 62q15-17 28 0t28 0 28 0M8 79q15-17 28 0t28 0 28 0" stroke="#659eaf" stroke-width="5"/><path d="M33 25h34M33 25l7-7M67 25l-7 7" stroke="#a0bfa9"/></svg>

items.label: Hydroelectric
items.art: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" stroke="#254554" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M23 17h43l8 69H14z" fill="#b5c4c8"/><path d="M29 33h29v20H29zM29 62h29v12H29z"/><path d="M74 44q12-11 18 0M75 60q12-11 18 0M77 76q12-11 16 0" stroke="#65a6c2"/></svg>

items.label: Nuclear (uranium)
items.art: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" stroke="#254554" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="36" ry="13" stroke="#b297bc"/><ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="36" ry="13" transform="rotate(60 50 50)" stroke="#b297bc"/><ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="36" ry="13" transform="rotate(120 50 50)" stroke="#b297bc"/><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="8" fill="#d99b7a"/></svg>
items.why: Conventional nuclear power uses uranium, a finite fuel taken from the ground.

items.label: Oil
items.art: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" stroke="#254554" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M24 15h52v70H24z" fill="#bd9876"/><path d="M21 25h58M21 75h58"/><path d="M50 34q-22 23-10 31 10 8 20-2 7-9-10-29z" fill="#4c6069"/></svg>
items.why: Oil forms over millions of years, much more slowly than we use it.

items.label: Natural gas
items.art: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" stroke="#254554" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M48 12q25 19 13 35 12 0 16-12 20 38-9 51-39 15-43-22-3-17 14-34-2 21 10 18 8-15-1-36z" fill="#e4ad70"/><path d="M51 51q-19 22-6 30 25 8 12-21z" fill="#f5d77f"/></svg>
items.why: Natural gas is a fossil fuel that forms over millions of years.

items.label: Coal
items.art: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100" fill="none" stroke="#254554" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 67l12-35 31-8 28 17 6 30-28 12-30-4z" fill="#526572"/><path d="M24 32l22 29 9-37M46 61l43 10M46 61l-15 18" stroke="#9caaab"/></svg>
items.why: Coal forms over millions of years and is used up when burned.

notes:
Focus: distinguish replenished sources from finite fuels. Renewable does not mean impact-free. Nuclear energy is classified here by its conventional uranium fuel.

Content reference: U.S. Energy Information Administration — sources of energy.

Symbols are editable inline SVG; no generated image assets.
